description.en: The village project with Mrs Birkett: the finest view above the lake, solid foundations on the rock, larch timber and planks from the wood, a room with wide windows, a steep path with steps up from the lake, coloured panes for the seasons, and the first guests and tourists.
description.sl: Vaški projekt z gospo Birkett: najlepši razgled nad jezerom, trdni temelji na pečini, macesnov les in plohi iz gozda, soba s širokimi okni, strma pot s stopnicami od jezera, barvna stekla za letne čase ter prvi gostje in turisti.
description.it: Il progetto del paese con la signora Birkett: la vista più bella sopra il lago, fondamenta solide sulla roccia, legno di larice e assi dal bosco, una stanza con finestre larghe, un sentiero ripido con i gradini dal lago, i vetri colorati per le stagioni, e i primi ospiti e turisti.
description.de: Das Dorfprojekt mit Frau Birkett: der schönste Ausblick über dem See, ein festes Fundament auf dem Felsen, Lärchenholz und Bretter aus dem Wald, ein Raum mit breiten Fenstern, ein steiler Weg mit Stufen vom See herauf, bunte Scheiben für die Jahreszeiten und die ersten Gäste und Touristen.

words.example_en: What a view! You can see the whole lake.
words.example_sl: Kakšen razgled! Vidi se vse jezero.
words.example_it: Che vista! Si vede tutto il lago.
words.example_de: Was für eine Aussicht! Man sieht den ganzen See.
words.note: A view is what you see from a high place: a room with a view.
words.note_sl: A view je tisto, kar vidiš z visokega kraja: a room with a view.
words.note_it: A view è quello che vedi da un posto alto: a room with a view.
words.note_de: A view ist, was man von einem hohen Ort sieht: a room with a view.

words.example_en: The station stands on a big rock.
words.example_it: Il belvedere sta su una grossa roccia.
words.example_de: Das Häuschen steht auf einem großen Felsen.
words.note: A rock is big and part of the hill; a stone is small enough to pick up.
words.note_sl: A rock je velika skala, del hriba; a stone je kamen, ki ga lahko pobereš.
words.note_it: A rock è grande e fa parte del monte; a stone è un sasso che puoi raccogliere.
words.note_de: A rock ist groß und Teil des Berges; a stone ist ein Stein, den man aufheben kann.

words.note: Solid as a rock: strong, it doesn't move.
words.note_sl: Solid as a rock: trden kot skala, ne premakne se.
words.note_it: Solid as a rock: solido come una roccia, non si muove.
words.note_de: Solid as a rock: stabil wie ein Fels, es bewegt sich nicht.

words.example_en: The timber is larch, from the wood by the lake.
words.example_sl: Les je macesnov, iz gozda ob jezeru.
words.example_it: Il legname è di larice, dal bosco vicino al lago.
words.example_de: Das Bauholz ist Lärche, aus dem Wald am See.
words.note: Timber is wood for building. In America: lumber.
words.note_sl: Timber je les za gradnjo. V Ameriki: lumber.
words.note_it: Timber è il legno da costruzione. In America: lumber.
words.note_de: Timber ist Holz zum Bauen. In Amerika: lumber.

words.example_en: Carry the planks one at a time.
words.example_it: Portate le assi una alla volta.
words.example_de: Tragt die Planken eine nach der anderen.
words.note: A plank is long, flat and thick; a board can be thinner.
words.note_sl: A plank je dolga, ravna in debela deska; a board je lahko tanjša.
words.note_it: A plank è lunga, piatta e spessa; a board può essere più sottile.
words.note_de: A plank ist lang, flach und dick; a board kann dünner sein.

words.example_en: The room has big windows on three sides.
words.example_sl: Soba ima velika okna na treh straneh.
words.example_it: La stanza ha grandi finestre su tre lati.
words.example_de: Der Raum hat große Fenster auf drei Seiten.
words.note: Room is also space: there's room for six people.
words.note_sl: Room pomeni tudi prostor: there's room for six people.
words.note_it: Room vuol dire anche spazio: there's room for six people.
words.note_de: Room heißt auch Platz: there's room for six people.

words.example_en: The windows are wide, for the whole view.
words.example_sl: Okna so široka, za ves razgled.
words.example_it: Le finestre sono larghe, per tutta la vista.
words.example_de: Die Fenster sind breit, für die ganze Aussicht.
words.note: Wide, wider, the widest. Wide open: open all the way.
words.note_sl: Wide, wider, the widest. Wide open: na stežaj odprt.
words.note_it: Wide, wider, the widest. Wide open: spalancato.
words.note_de: Wide, wider, the widest. Wide open: weit offen.

words.example_en: There are a hundred steps up from the lake.
words.example_sl: Od jezera vodi gor sto stopnic.
words.example_de: Vom See führen hundert Stufen herauf.
words.note: Mind the step! Step by step: slowly, one at a time.
words.note_sl: Mind the step! Pazi na stopnico. Step by step: korak za korakom.
words.note_it: Mind the step! Attento al gradino. Step by step: passo dopo passo.
words.note_de: Mind the step! Vorsicht, Stufe. Step by step: Schritt für Schritt.

words.example_en: The path is steep, but it's short.
words.example_it: Il sentiero è ripido, ma è corto.
words.example_de: Der Weg ist steil, aber kurz.
words.note: Steep goes up fast: a steep path, a steep hill.
words.note_sl: Steep gre hitro navzgor: a steep path, a steep hill.
words.note_it: Steep sale in fretta: a steep path, a steep hill.
words.note_de: Steep geht schnell bergauf: a steep path, a steep hill.

words.example_en: The green pane is for spring.
words.example_it: Il vetro verde è per la primavera.
words.example_de: Die grüne Scheibe ist für den Frühling.
words.note: A pane is one piece of glass in a window: a window pane.
words.note_sl: A pane je ena šipa v oknu: a window pane.
words.note_it: A pane è un pezzo di vetro della finestra: a window pane.
words.note_de: A pane ist eine Glasscheibe im Fenster: a window pane.

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett puts coloured glass in the windows.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett v okna vstavi barvno steklo.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett mette dei vetri colorati alle finestre.
words.example_de: Frau Birkett setzt buntes Glas in die Fenster.
words.note: British spelling: colour, coloured. American: color, colored.
words.note_sl: Britansko: colour, coloured. Ameriško: color, colored.
words.note_it: In britannico: colour, coloured. In americano: color, colored.
words.note_de: Britisch: colour, coloured. Amerikanisch: color, colored.

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett brings her guests from the inn.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett pripelje svoje goste iz gostilne.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett porta i suoi ospiti dalla locanda.
words.example_de: Frau Birkett bringt ihre Gäste aus dem Gasthaus mit.
words.note: Be my guest! Please, go ahead.
words.note_sl: Be my guest! Izvoli, kar daj.
words.note_it: Be my guest! Prego, fai pure.
words.note_de: Be my guest! Bitte, nur zu.

words.example_en: The tourists come up from the boats on the lake.
words.example_sl: Turisti pridejo gor z ladjic na jezeru.
words.example_it: I turisti salgono dai battelli del lago.
words.example_de: Die Touristen kommen von den Booten auf dem See herauf.
words.note: The first tourists came to the Lakes in the 1700s, with Thomas West's guidebook.
words.note_sl: Prvi turisti so v Lake District prišli v 18. stoletju, z vodnikom Thomasa Westa.
words.note_it: I primi turisti arrivarono nel Lake District nel Settecento, con la guida di Thomas West.
words.note_de: Die ersten Touristen kamen im 18. Jahrhundert mit Thomas Wests Reiseführer in den Lake District.
